timing.per_item_note: each item is its own request (own state): one prefix prefill + one candidate batch + the label decodes; nothing is generated

speed_sample.what_it_measures: tg128: 128 tokens generated after an empty prompt, with all 32 layers on the Vulkan device (-ngl 99 = the fully-resident placement this arm measured), KV cache q4_0 (the same KV type the run's fit plan chose) and flash attention on (the engine's own ctypes binding sets LLAMA_FLASH_ATTN_TYPE_ENABLED, src/typed_gguf/engine/session.py:731, so the bench matches the engine)
speed_sample.why_not_a_chat_sample: the run itself generates no free text (readout `sequence` scores fixed label candidates), so tg tok/s cannot be read off the 30 items; a bench completion is the smallest honest instrument for the 'is the full-GPU speed real' question

run.run_log: run.log next to this report (exit code + wall ms + exact command per item)
